author: Parker Rehm
title: No. 8 Baylor breaks past No. 9 BYU to open Big 12 Tournament play - NewsBreak
text:
By Parker Rehm No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
SURPRISE, AZ ( FOX 44 ) — Baylor is moving on in the desert after putting up seven runs in the sixth and seventh innings to complete the comeback and take down No. 9 BYU to advance to the Big 12 Tournament quarterfinals with a 13-9 win on Wednesday night.
The Bears opened the scoring with a 3-0 lead in the first two innings but BYU responded in a big way in the bottom of the third. A six-run inning put up by the Cougars gave BYU the lead, one they didn’t give back until the sixth.
A three-run bomb by Brady Janusek gave the Bears the lead for good, adding onto his Baylor freshman single-season record 14 home runs on the season.
Senior Ethan Calder picked up the win with 4.2 innings pitched in relief, allowing just two earned runs on three hits with eight strikeouts.
Baylor advances to play No. 1 Kansas tomorrow in the Big 12 Tournament quarterfinals on Thursday, May 21st at 12:30 p.m. CT.
